text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm Rhein Kraft! My goal is to win the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The way all the Tiara Umamusume ran gave 
me dreams and courage...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to run a race that leaves a lasting 
impression on someone too... That's the 
kind of running I want to do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
